messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

建議主軸：Start with 3GPP NTN-NR, because the sources directly connect Wireless Communication market interest to measurable channel impairments and to R&S SMW200A / FSW signal-generation and signal-analysis capabilities for NTN testing [34][4][27].
### 推薦先賣
**R&S SMW200A for NTN signal generation / channel emulation**: 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industries, and the source states SMW200A channel emulation for NTN testing includes long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading [34].
**R&S FSW for NTN signal analysis / component testing**: NTN component testing is described as using a DUT with R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW; FSW is listed with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [27].
**Do not overclaim Wi-Fi 7 or full regulatory coverage**: the knowledge base supports Wi-Fi 7 measurable needs such as 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096-QAM, MLO, STR, eMLSR, and 6 GHz band, but it does not state a direct SMW200A / FSW Wi-Fi 7 option mapping [19].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMW200A Vector Signal Generator | 3GPP NTN-NR signal generation and end-to-end RF satellite link emulation | Firmware version ≥ 5.30; B14 or B15 with R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading; supports satellite trajectory modelling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [4]. Component testing summary lists frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, and up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555 [27]. | The source directly says SMW200A channel emulation capabilities are used for NTN testing and include long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading [34]. | [4][27][34] | Formal product specifications still need to be checked because the component-testing passage says the values are a 2025 presentation summary [27]. |
| R&S FSW Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | NTN component signal analysis | Frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz; analysis software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM signal analysis, and vector signal analysis [27]. | The NTN component-testing source explicitly lists DUT + SMW200A + FSW as the setup and gives FSW analysis capability values [27]. | [27] | FCC FR2 regulatory radiated spurious-emission range is listed as 9 kHz–200 GHz, so FSW up to 90 GHz overrange does not by itself cover the full FCC FR2 range stated in the regulatory table [31]. |
| R&S CMP200 with R&S CM-Z310A UWB head | UWB generation / analysis in the UWB-head operating range | CM-Z310A generator frequency range is 6 GHz to 13 GHz; analyzer frequency range is 4 GHz to 13 GHz; analyzer displayed average noise level is < –154.5 dBm/Hz from 4 GHz to 13 GHz at +15 °C to +35 °C [1]. | It provides a measurable generator/analyzer path for UWB-range work inside 4/6–13 GHz [1]. | [1] | Regulatory UWB frequency ranges are listed as CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz and FCC 9 kHz < 40 GHz, with another FCC note of 100 GHz, so the CM-Z310A range is not shown as full regulatory coverage [31]. |
| R&S CMP200 with R&S CMPHEAD30 | FR2 28 GHz / 39 GHz generation and analysis extension | CMPHEAD30 covers 28 GHz band 24.25–31.80 GHz and 39 GHz band 37.00–43.50 GHz; generator output level ranges include 28 GHz PEP –84 dBm to +20 dBm and 37–40 GHz PEP –78 dBm to +19 dBm; analyzer frequency extension is 23.45–24.25 GHz and 43.50–44.30 GHz; analyzer frequency error is < ±0.01 ppm [25]. | It maps measurable FR2 band coverage and frequency accuracy to a generator/analyzer head capability [25]. | [25] | The passages do not connect CMPHEAD30 to a specific market requirement beyond FR2-range capability, and FCC FR2 regulatory range can extend to 200 GHz [31]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3GPP NTN-NR end-to-end RF satellite link emulation | R&S SMW200A firmware ≥ 5.30 + B14 or B15 + R&S SMW-K820; R&S Space Nexus can generate SMW200A fading files from satellite trajectory [4]. | Market pull: 5G NTN-NR interest from chipset/device, automotive, and satellite/space industries; measurable parameters: long path delay, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [34][4]. | R&S Space Nexus is available on request, so availability and licensing need confirmation [4]. |
| NTN component testing | R&S SMW200A + R&S FSW [27]. | Measurable parameters: generator frequency up to 67 GHz / overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz or 4 GHz with SMW-K555, analyzer frequency up to 85 GHz / overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [27]. | The source says these are 2025 presentation summary values and formal specifications should be checked [27]. |
| FCC / CE wireless regulatory RF analysis | Spectrum analyzer / EMI receiver path; R&S FSW is one listed analyzer family [31]. | Regulatory measurable ranges include 5G NR FR1, 5G NR FR2, Wi-Fi, and UWB frequency ranges; the source states RF analysis needs a spectrum analyzer, EMC test standards need a test EMI receiver, and RSE testing can use both types [31]. | Full accredited test scope, FCC KDB details, and some FR2 RSE conditions are unresolved in the knowledge base [10]. |
### 限制
The strongest fully supported chain is NTN-NR: market interest → measurable delay/Doppler/fading/frequency/bandwidth parameters → SMW200A and FSW capabilities [34][4][27].
The Wi-Fi 7 chain is only supported through the market and measurable-parameter stages; the passages do not state a confirmed SMW200A / FSW Wi-Fi 7 option mapping [19].
Full regulatory analyzer coverage cannot be assumed from FSW alone because the regulatory table lists FCC FR2 up to 200 GHz while FSW is listed up to 85 GHz, or 90 GHz overrange [31][27].

[[R&S CM-Z310A]] UWB head 是 [[R&S CMP200]] 的 ultra wideband extension：

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| Order No. | 1215.0000.02 |
| Connection cable | [[R&S CM-Z33A]]，3 m，1215.0500.02 |
| Step attenuator | RF 1、RF 2、RF 3、RF 4，user controlled |
| Attenuation range | 0 dB to 20 dB |
| Attenuation step size | 1 dB |
| Generator frequency range | 6 GHz to 13 GHz |
| Generator output level range | RMS，step attenuator 20 dB：–110 dBm to –46 dBm；step attenuator 0 dB overrange：up to –10 dBm |
| Analyzer frequency range | 4 GHz to 13 GHz |
| Analyzer absolute maximum | 30 V DC，+15 dBm |
| Analyzer displayed average noise level | +15 °C to +35 °C，4 GHz to 13 GHz：< –154.5 dBm/Hz meas. |
| Calibration interval | 24 months |
| Dimensions | 245 mm × 185 mm × 38 mm |
| Weight | 約 2.0 kg |

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

LTM TTCN-3 Test cases- ss stack Requirements Analysis › RACH-less LTM requirements
用於 TC 7.1.1.3.28、7.1.1.3.28A.x、7.1.1.3.30、7.1.1.5.11 與 7.1.3.5.14 的 [[RACH-less LTM]] additional requirements：

- Target DRB pre-configuration：`f_NR_SS_CommonRadioBearerConfig` before switch。
- Target [[C-RNTI]] assignment with FollowOnFlag：`f_NR_SS_C_RNTI_Config(FollowOnFlag=true)`。
- Target UL grant OnSR：`f_NR_ULGrantConfiguration_Common(cs_UL_GrantConfig_OnSR)`。
- [[RRCReconfigurationComplete]] on target SRB1：`SRB.receive(car_NR_SRB1_RrcPdu_IND)`。
- Source cell cleanup：`f_NR_SS_SRBs_DRBs_Release` + `f_NR_SS_SRBs_DRBs_Config(omit)`。
- UL grant stop on source：`f_NR_ULGrantConfiguration_Stop`。

02160280 › 重點摘要
- 太陽電力調節模組含 36 組 shunt stage，控制共 38 串太陽電池串；每組分流器由 MOSFET 開關與隔離繼電器組成。
- 表 3 記錄電池充電過電壓保護：Level 1 在 33.8 V、latency 2 sec. 時 shunt on 1/2 strings，disable level 33.3 V；Level 2 在 34.0 V、latency 0 sec. 時 shunt on all strings，disable level 33.3 V。
- 表 4 記錄 MOSFET switch LCL 類型 A、B、C、D-1、D-2、E-1、E-2 的 Max Load、Trip-off Load 與 Latching Current Limit；來源稱限電流保護先限制電流，若異常持續超過 10 ms，視為短路並啟動過電流保護關閉 MOSFET。
- PCDU 內部 DCDC converter 有 INT +5V、INT ±15V、INT +12V 三種規格；外部 DCDC converter 有 EXT +5.2V 與 EXT ±15V 兩種規格；內外部 DCDC 均有備援設計。
- PCDU 資料與介面使用備援 RS-422 / UART 介面；另有兩個 RS-422 指令與 5 個 RS-422 high priority command（HPC）獨立介面，用於失去通聯緊急狀況下繞過 CDMU 飛行軟體控制關鍵元件。
- 控制軟體演算法位於 [[CDMU]]，主要以 4 Hz 調節 36 組分流器，分為 sensor data processing、charge control processing、ampere-hour integration、charge protection processing、charge control execution、battery temperature sensor data processing 等六階段。
- 充電控制分為高電流充電 / Direct Energy Transfer（DET）與限制電流充電 / taper charge；充電電壓設定為 33.3 V，若電池電流不高於 12 A，將剩餘太陽電力直接對電池充電。
- 電能平衡分析結合電力預算、軌道特性、衛星飛行姿態、操作模式、太陽能板與衛星電池性能；來源稱這是驗證電力次系統是否達到需求的最主要分析。
- 來源列出軌道條件：720 km / 98.27°、最差 LTDN 09:45、夏季 / 軌道太陽角 26.5°、軌道週期 99.19 分鐘、太陽夜間時間 33.41 分鐘。
- 表 7 記錄任務壽命終期第五年電力預算：Normal 268.61 W、Rest 264.59 W、ASH 221.81 W；其中 Payload 為 96.32 W / 91.77 W / 55 W。
- 來源稱太陽能板最大輸出約 630 W；配合任務姿態與日照 / 陰影時間比，扣除 PCDU 調節耗損後每軌道輸出平均功率約 348.73 W，日照平均功率 529 W。
- 衛星電池放電深度約 21% 至 24%；依供應商評估，五年壽命下正常使用電池容量僅減少 16%。
- 來源稱以細部設計審查階段為例，可得到約 25% 電力餘裕度，對比表 1 的 EOL +3% power margin requirement，可證明電力次系統設計符合福衛五號系統設計。
- 結論稱[[FORMOSAT-5]]於 2017-08-25 升空後已超過六個月飛行任務，電力次系統行為表現與預期相同、未出現異常，顯示該次系統成熟且可作為[[國家太空中心]]標準平台。

- 來源稱[[FORMOSAT-5]] / 福衛五號是台灣首次由[[國家太空中心]]自行完成設計、分析、組裝、驗證測試的 spacecraft。
- 來源稱[[FORMOSAT-5]] 任務包含 2 m panchromatic / 4 m multispectral [[Remote Sensing Instrument]]（RSI）光學遙測酬載，以及 [[Advance Ionosphere Probe]]；任務壽命目標為五年。
- [[衛星電力次系統]]供應 spacecraft bus 與 payload instruments 所需電力，管理電力安全，調節太陽能板與衛星電池電力，使衛星可在五年任務壽命中正常運作。
- 電力次系統硬體包含：(1) 太陽能板、(2) [[PCDU]] / Power Control and Distribution Unit、(3) 衛星電池、(4) 衛星線束；控制軟體演算法建立於 [[CDMU]] 中。
- 來源的表 1 記錄主要設計參數：EOL nominal operation 每日至少 +3% power margin、primary power bus 為 unregulated 28 V（表中寫 `28V +5.6/4.0V`）、secondary power bus 含 +4.8 V ~ +5.6 V 與 ±15 V 範圍、battery low voltage protection 22 V、battery high voltage protection 超過 34 V 時 shunt off all charge regulators、EPS 不需 ground uplink command 即可運作、各 equipment 與 payload instrument 需 over-current protection。
- 來源稱福衛五號[[衛星電力次系統]]由[[國家太空中心]]主導；[[PCDU]]由中科院與[[國家太空中心]]設計、製作與驗證測試；衛星線束由[[國家太空中心]]設計並委託國外製作；演算法與控制軟體由[[國家太空中心]]設計、編碼與系統驗證。
- 太陽能板由兩片相同 solar panel wings 組成；每面太陽能板為 20s 19p 組態，每串 20 顆 triple-junction GaAs 太陽電池，來源稱在軌最大約 630 W 電力。
- 表 2 記錄每面太陽能板於 5 年壽命終期、夏至軌道的最大輸出參數：Voc 41.82 V、Isc 9.45 A、Vmp 35.67 V、Imp 8.85 A。
- 衛星電池組採用鋰離子電芯，總容量 24 Ah；每顆電芯額定容量 1.5 Ah，8 顆串聯、16 串並聯，亦即 8s16p 組態；來源列出 Sony 18650HC 電芯，額定容量至少 1.5 Ah / 5.4 Wh、能量密度 129 Wh/kg、最大充電電壓 4.2 V、最低放電電壓 2.5 V。
- 來源稱衛星電池組外觀尺寸約 345 mm × 192 mm × 95 mm，質量約 6.6 kg；長期不用時以 C/10 放電至 20.0 V、殘餘電量低於 5%，乾燥保存於 10 °C 至 20 °C（+4 °C 最佳）。
- 電池安全保護包含 [[PTC]] 多重開關；若短路造成過度放電，PTC 電阻上升以限制放電電流在 1C 穩定狀態，反應時間 1–2 秒；短路解除後可恢復。
- 飛行操作中充電原則為定電壓 33.6 V 控制，額定電流不超過 C/2，搭配 taper charge；軟體演算法使用電壓感測器讀值做充電調節。
- 來源稱 [[UVLO]] / Under-voltage Lockout 在電池降至 22 V 時關閉電力控制單元，使衛星休眠；當主電源恢復至 26 V 以上時，電力控制單元自動開啟，[[CDMU]] 與飛行軟體自動開啟以恢復操作。

建議主軸：Start with 3GPP NTN-NR, because the sources directly connect Wireless Communication market interest to measurable channel impairments and to R&S SMW200A / FSW signal-generation and signal-analysis capabilities for NTN testing [34][4][27].
### 推薦先賣
**R&S SMW200A for NTN signal generation / channel emulation**: 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industries, and the source states SMW200A channel emulation for NTN testing includes long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading [34].
**R&S FSW for NTN signal analysis / component testing**: NTN component testing is described as using a DUT with R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW; FSW is listed with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [27].
**Do not overclaim Wi-Fi 7 or full regulatory coverage**: the knowledge base supports Wi-Fi 7 measurable needs such as 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096-QAM, MLO, STR, eMLSR, and 6 GHz band, but it does not state a direct SMW200A / FSW Wi-Fi 7 option mapping [19].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMW200A Vector Signal Generator | 3GPP NTN-NR signal generation and end-to-end RF satellite link emulation | Firmware version ≥ 5.30; B14 or B15 with R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading; supports satellite trajectory modelling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [4]. Component testing summary lists frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, and up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555 [27]. | The source directly says SMW200A channel emulation capabilities are used for NTN testing and include long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading [34]. | [4][27][34] | Formal product specifications still need to be checked because the component-testing passage says the values are a 2025 presentation summary [27]. |
| R&S FSW Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | NTN component signal analysis | Frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz; analysis software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM signal analysis, and vector signal analysis [27]. | The NTN component-testing source explicitly lists DUT + SMW200A + FSW as the setup and gives FSW analysis capability values [27]. | [27] | FCC FR2 regulatory radiated spurious-emission range is listed as 9 kHz–200 GHz, so FSW up to 90 GHz overrange does not by itself cover the full FCC FR2 range stated in the regulatory table [31]. |
| R&S CMP200 with R&S CM-Z310A UWB head | UWB generation / analysis in the UWB-head operating range | CM-Z310A generator frequency range is 6 GHz to 13 GHz; analyzer frequency range is 4 GHz to 13 GHz; analyzer displayed average noise level is < –154.5 dBm/Hz from 4 GHz to 13 GHz at +15 °C to +35 °C [1]. | It provides a measurable generator/analyzer path for UWB-range work inside 4/6–13 GHz [1]. | [1] | Regulatory UWB frequency ranges are listed as CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz and FCC 9 kHz < 40 GHz, with another FCC note of 100 GHz, so the CM-Z310A range is not shown as full regulatory coverage [31]. |
| R&S CMP200 with R&S CMPHEAD30 | FR2 28 GHz / 39 GHz generation and analysis extension | CMPHEAD30 covers 28 GHz band 24.25–31.80 GHz and 39 GHz band 37.00–43.50 GHz; generator output level ranges include 28 GHz PEP –84 dBm to +20 dBm and 37–40 GHz PEP –78 dBm to +19 dBm; analyzer frequency extension is 23.45–24.25 GHz and 43.50–44.30 GHz; analyzer frequency error is < ±0.01 ppm [25]. | It maps measurable FR2 band coverage and frequency accuracy to a generator/analyzer head capability [25]. | [25] | The passages do not connect CMPHEAD30 to a specific market requirement beyond FR2-range capability, and FCC FR2 regulatory range can extend to 200 GHz [31]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3GPP NTN-NR end-to-end RF satellite link emulation | R&S SMW200A firmware ≥ 5.30 + B14 or B15 + R&S SMW-K820; R&S Space Nexus can generate SMW200A fading files from satellite trajectory [4]. | Market pull: 5G NTN-NR interest from chipset/device, automotive, and satellite/space industries; measurable parameters: long path delay, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [34][4]. | R&S Space Nexus is available on request, so availability and licensing need confirmation [4]. |
| NTN component testing | R&S SMW200A + R&S FSW [27]. | Measurable parameters: generator frequency up to 67 GHz / overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz or 4 GHz with SMW-K555, analyzer frequency up to 85 GHz / overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [27]. | The source says these are 2025 presentation summary values and formal specifications should be checked [27]. |
| FCC / CE wireless regulatory RF analysis | Spectrum analyzer / EMI receiver path; R&S FSW is one listed analyzer family [31]. | Regulatory measurable ranges include 5G NR FR1, 5G NR FR2, Wi-Fi, and UWB frequency ranges; the source states RF analysis needs a spectrum analyzer, EMC test standards need a test EMI receiver, and RSE testing can use both types [31]. | Full accredited test scope, FCC KDB details, and some FR2 RSE conditions are unresolved in the knowledge base [10]. |
### 限制
The strongest fully supported chain is NTN-NR: market interest → measurable delay/Doppler/fading/frequency/bandwidth parameters → SMW200A and FSW capabilities [34][4][27].
The Wi-Fi 7 chain is only supported through the market and measurable-parameter stages; the passages do not state a confirmed SMW200A / FSW Wi-Fi 7 option mapping [19].
Full regulatory analyzer coverage cannot be assumed from FSW alone because the regulatory table lists FCC FR2 up to 200 GHz while FSW is listed up to 85 GHz, or 90 GHz overrange [31][27].
